hits.title: Olipop taps Electrolit head as next CEO | Food Dive
hits.snippet: # Olipop taps Electrolit head as next CEO ... Founder Ben Goodwin will move into a more innovation-focused role at the prebiotic soda brand while Christian Patiño Webb takes the top executive spot. ... - Olipop has appointed Electolit chief executive Christian Patiño Webb as its next CEO as the prebiotic soda brand looks to expand growth after passing the half billion-dollar sales mark last year. - Patiño Webb will take the top position later this month, with current CEO and founder Ben Goodwin set to step into a research and strategy focused role, according to a LinkedIn post Tuesday. - Webb will be tasked with charting the new phase of growth for Olipop to "help drive the business in a mission-aligned way" as Goodwin hopes to "double down" on areas like innovation, he said in the LinkedIn post.

He also worked in previous leadership roles at Procter & Gamble, Johnson & Johnson, Red Bull, and Unilever, and other high-growth brands.
